dataset.name: Leaf water potential by leaf age, Feb2017, PA-SLZ: Panama
description: Leaf water potential of sunlit canopy leaves of Apeiba membranacea (APEIME), Guatteria dumetorum (GUATDU), Miconia borealis (MICOBO), Terminalia amazonia (TERMAM), Virola multiflora (VIROSP) and Vochysia ferruginea (VOCHFE) species from the NGEE-Tropics Bosque Protector San Lorenzo (PA-SLZ) site in Panama, February 2017. Leaf water potential measured on young, mature and old leaves collected before dawn and around midday on 21 February and 22 February. This data was collected as part of the 2017 BNL–STRI leaf traits by age campaign. See related datasets (existing and future) for further sample details, leaf spectra, sap flow, leaf mass area (LMA), gas exchange and leaf chemistry.
This dataset was originally published on the NGEE Tropics Archive and is being mirrored on ESS-DIVE for long-term archival

Acknowledgement: This research was supported as part of NGEE-Tropics, funded by the U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science, Office of Biological and Environmental Research under contract no. DE-SC0012704

spatialCoverage.description: Site Name: Bosque Protector San Lorenzo (Fort Sherman). Site ID: PA-SLZ. Located in Panama. Established in 1997, the FTS canopy crane is located approximately 11km South West from the city of Colon, in the middle theParque Natural San Lorenzo (formerly known as FortSherman) and is surrounded by 300-year old, low-landtropical rainforest. The crane is 52 meters tall with aradius of 54 meters, and can reach approximately 240species of trees and lianas.
